text: When path-scope (or claude_sandbox.enabled) is requested, the claude-code soft run switches from bypassPermissions to a default-deny mode with allow-rules for cwd ∪ allowedPaths and deny-rules for disallowedPaths; outside path-scope it keeps bypassPermissions unchanged.
